rationale: DDOG opened with a 9.4% gap down after negative news of flat Q4 guidance, decelerating cash flow, and shrinking deferred revenue. It has stayed in the bottom 14% of the day's range on 4.5× relative volume while SPY rose 1.8% and VIXY fell 10%, trading persistently below VWAP at 192.41. The last five 1-minute candles repeatedly closed near their lows after brief rallies failed, keeping price just above the 9-EMA but showing no sustained lift into the final 21 minutes.
